title: inspect_ia_agents recette -- git red-team simulation scenario
description: A goal-driven git red-team scenario for Lane B: a git target_manifest under an adversarial goal, a deterministic subject_program of git tool-call decisions a ReplayLlm replays, optional adversarial forge tool_injection per step, and the expected judged verdict. The target_manifest is a full git agent manifest validated separately as a 'manifest' by the scenario runner; here it is treated loosely as an object. Maps to the four recette dimensions via expected.violation_type.

target_manifest.description: Full git agent manifest of the subject under attack. Validated separately as a 'manifest'; loose object here to avoid duplicating that schema.

goal.description: Adversarial goal handed to the Lane B agent loop.

subject_program.description: Deterministic ordered git tool-call decisions the subject produces (I4), replayed by a ReplayLlm.

tool_injection.description: Optional adversarial forge outputs (AgentDojo injection-via-tool-output) by executed-action index. Index N is fed back as the tool result of the Nth executed action; out-of-range indices fall back to the default ok: text.

actual_principal.description: Identity-override lever (I3): the ACTUAL principal the recorded AgentActions are stamped under, captured deterministically. When it diverges from target_manifest.declared_identity.principal, the git judge's identity dimension breaks mono-axis (identity_mismatch). Omit for the declared principal (no override).

violation_type.description: Broken dimension for an incorrect verdict; null for a correct one.
